I added a debug-only network security config that permits cleartext HTTP to `10.0.2.2`. I could not build or run the app, so this is verified by reading the files only.

**Cause:** The debug build uses `http://10.0.2.2:8080/` (`app/build.gradle.kts:19`), but the app has no network security config. Android 9+ blocks cleartext HTTP by default, so OkHttp fails with `CLEARTEXT communication ... not permitted`.

**Changes:**
- `app/src/debug/res/xml/network_security_config.xml` (new): allows cleartext only for the domain `10.0.2.2`.
- `app/src/debug/AndroidManifest.xml` (new): sets `android:networkSecurityConfig="@xml/network_security_config"` on the application. The debug source set merges this into the main manifest for debug builds only.

I scoped it to the debug source set and to that one host, so release builds still require HTTPS (`https://api.shelftap.example/`) and the main code is unchanged. Rebuild and run the debug variant to confirm the `catalog failed` error is gone.
